waits.words: Building on the sea floor under water isn't possible yet, so the whole colony waits for it.
The domes sit on the sea-floor site, so they wait for it too.

answer.summary: You asked for a colony of glass domes on the sea floor: a great central dome, four residential pods, a kelp farm dome, a forge, a market and mess dome, an air-lock gatehouse and an observation tower. All of it is written into the plan. Architect can't build under water yet, so the sea-floor site, the domes and the glass tunnels between them wait until it can.
